title: 七月全球波动：印度市场竟成，避风港？
speaker: Christina Woon

segments.en: India was also your contrarian view as well. It was largely the narrative that this is the sort of non-AI alternative sort of play. Is that still the case for you?
segments.zh: 印度也是你的逆向观点。当时的主流叙事是，这是非人工智能的替代选择。你现在还这么认为吗？

segments.en: Yeah, actually, it would say even more so now. Again, if we take July as a good testing bid for balance within portfolios, India is one that actually held out reasonably well.
segments.zh: 是的，实际上现在更是如此。如果我们把七月作为组合平衡的良好测试，印度实际上表现相当稳健。

segments.en: If you looked at some of the numbers that we had seen come out of the previous quarter or even some of the monthly numbers in certain sectors in consumer, for example, these held up much better than expected.
segments.zh: 如果你看一下上一季度的一些数据，甚至某些消费领域的月度数据，这些数据都比预期要好得多。

segments.en: And if you look at the market, it was a lot more resilient than some other parts that were selling off as some other parts of Asia that were selling off more heavily.
segments.zh: 而且市场比其他一些地区更具韧性，其他亚洲地区出现了更大幅度的调整。

segments.en: So again, bringing it back to that point about diversification. Having some exposure, I would say, to some of these markets that are perhaps a bit less correlated to tech, will prove, I suppose, positive or beneficial for having a smooth ride.
segments.zh: 所以再次回到多元配置的观点。我认为，对某些与科技相关性较低的市场进行一定配置，将有助于实现平稳运行。
